member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Register(RaceDay.Api.DTOs.RegisterDto)
member.summary: Register a new account as an Organiser or a Participant.
member.remarks: Expects first name, last name, email, password (min 8 characters), role ("Organiser" or "Participant"), and optionally phone number and date of birth. Registering as an Organiser also requires the organiser code, so that nobody can simply give themselves organiser rights. Returns the created user (the password is never returned).
